name: crita-portfolio
description: Crita Creative LLP — selected work portfolio: website, PowerPoint and PDF from one content source.

scripts.dev: npm run media && astro dev --root web
scripts.build:web: npm run media && astro build --root web
scripts.build:ppt: node ppt/build-art.mjs && node ppt/build-deck.mjs && node ppt/build-deck.mjs --presenter
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:pdf && npm run build:ppt && npm run check
